reviews.title: Beautiful location
reviews.author: Maureen D
reviews.text: What a beautiful spot. We had RV's and our location amongst trees was perfect. There was no power hook up, but the toilets/bathroom facilites were good.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：林间RV营位位置好，无电接驳，厕所/浴室设施不错。

reviews.title: Relaxing family day in sand and sun
reviews.author: InnaS61218
reviews.text: Really fun for digging and beach combing when the tide is out. Beware, when it comes back in it goes fast! :)
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：退潮挖沙赶海超好玩，但涨潮来得很快要小心。

reviews.title: Mixed Bag
reviews.author: Jill M
reviews.text: The campground was clean and well kept, however in the loop we were in, we had to walk to a group campground area for showers and it was set up like a parking lot. The sites were graveled and tenting would have been difficult. It was a short walk to the beach from our site and the trail around the campground was also nice. The dog could only be on the "rocky" beach area that was far away from our site. The tide goes out a very long way, so it was not ideal for that as the high tides were in the evening and early morning when we were there. It is right next to a town.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：营地干净但所在loop需去group区洗澡（像停车场）、碎石营位难搭帐篷；狗只能去远处的岩石海滩；退潮退得很远、涨潮在早晚，不理想；紧邻小镇。

reviews.title: Perfect spot to explore the beach.
reviews.author: Katelyn2727
reviews.text: Lovely beach for the whole family, very sandy but water shoes are a great idea. There are bathrooms and a nature house to explore.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：全家都爱的沙滩，沙子细但建议穿水鞋；有卫生间和自然小屋可参观。

reviews.title: Terrific and unique beach
reviews.text: Campsite for a couple = 2 stars. Campsite for active families = 5 stars. Campsite beach at high tide = 2 stars. Campsite beach at low tide = 5 stars. This campground is filled with families and children and may not fit the outdoor getaway that some might seek while camping. The central playground and bike track were busy at 8am through to 10pm, so select a site on the opposite end or perimeter if you are looking for a quieter experience. Book online 4 months in advance to get a better selection (or any selection.) Be aware of kids biking, drawing, playing on the roads as well. We stayed in site 68, which was decently treed, but only about 5 sites away from the playground. A tiny, shy deer came through the bush in the evening, which was about the most "camping" ish occurrence during our time here. The beach at low tide is excellent, even on the dog beach side of the park. There is a mix of rocks and sand, so shoes are helpful to get out past the cobble. Mountain views across the straight were good considering the recent forest fires in BC.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：情侣2星/带娃家庭5星/涨潮海滩2星/退潮海滩5星；中央游乐场8am-10pm都很吵，想安静选对角或外圈营位；提前4个月预订；住68号营位，树多但离游乐场仅5个营位；傍晚有小鹿穿过灌木；退潮海滩极好。

reviews.title: Great place for kids
reviews.text: We enjoyed a lovely camping trip at Rathtrevor. The day-use area is fantastic for picnics, and all-day beach fun. There are no dogs allowed on the beach in the summer but they can stay "at the top" (ie/ dry grass, walking trail, picnic tables). Camping is great, but here are some tidbits that might want to know: If you are on the outer edge of camping, there are pit toilets. They are wide-doored. However, they do not clean them very well. Unlike Miracle Beach campground, this place does not clean longer than 1-2 mins inside the toilets (we had the joy of being close and could see). They do spend time making the outside of it look nice though? In the lunch to evening times, these are filled with 100 flies. Stinks, dirt and pee accumulating all around the base. Yuck. Daytime bathroom in the "middle" ones (showers, flush toilets) are mucky. Do not let kids go barefoot, yuck. Washrooms could use better cleaning. Showers are hot. Too hot for many kids, almost burning. If you have little ones, bring a rubbermaid and fill it while in there and let cool first. There is a plug in the women's washrooms for sure for hairdryers (no wall-unit that I could see).
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：总体是愉快的露营之旅，日间区野餐很棒；但外圈旱厕打扫敷衍、苍蝇多、有味；中间淋浴/冲水厕所白天也脏；淋浴水烫得几乎烫伤小孩，建议带盆接水放凉；女卫生间有吹风机插座。

reviews.title: Stinks!
reviews.author: Mr Q
reviews.text: We decided to stay in the overflow loops this year...and this proved to be just as big a mistake as staying in the main campground. The outhouses are THE WORST I've ever dealt with. The putrid stench that emanated from the one in our loop wafted directly through our site all day long. It was so bad that we could sit or eat in our site, luckily we were with another couple, so we visited them a lot. When we complained FOUR TIMES, their idea of a solution was to simply pump it out...no washing or rinsing afterwards, just sucked it all out with a pumper truck and dove away, which only made things worse.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：overflow loop的旱厕是他用过最差的，恶臭整天飘进营位，投诉4次只抽走不冲洗，越弄越糟。

reviews.title: Lovely walk on the beach and inland
reviews.author: koyehj
reviews.text: Its a lovely combination of walking on the beach at low tide and then walking in a forested area (shade!) with a well trodden walking path. Great for photo taking. What was not advertised was there is a bicycle rental which I would highly recommend (only saw the rental when leaving), as one could spend a good part of the day there.
reviews.ratingNote: 页面明确显示5星。中文要点：退潮海滩+遮荫森林步道的组合很棒，适合拍照；还有自行车租赁（强烈推荐），能玩大半天。

reviews.title: Beautiful RV site
reviews.author: Mr Q
reviews.text: If you want peace and quiet definitely DO NOT come to this park. During the day, there wasn't a 10 minute interval where there wasn't at least one dog barking frantically...but usually more than one because they feed off each other. The only time things were "quiet" was after 10 pm. The bathrooms are disgusting and not cleaned often enough...parents, teach your children how to use a public bathroom WITHOUT urinating all over the seats....and flush when you are done; I don't need to see your deposit. The showers were brutally hot in the closest bathroom, so I had to walk another 100 yds to another one to keep from being scalded. There is no control over water temperature, it's done behind the scenes. The beach in the campground/RV section was nothing but rocks, so we had to take a 15 minute walk to the sandy side. Nice sunsets...but not going back anytime soon.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：想要清静千万别来；白天狗叫不断（互相传染），10点后才安静；厕所脏、打扫不够；淋浴水烫得吓人且无法调温；营地/RV区海滩全是石头，要走15分钟才到沙滩；日落美但不会再来。

reviews.title: Wonderful spot
reviews.author: Ady_JD
reviews.text: Wonderful beach. Lots of facilities, easy parking, pet and non pet areas, clean, well maintained. Gorgeous views, can walk out in shallows for a long way, just wonderful
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：海滩很棒、设施多、停车方便、有宠物/非宠物分区、干净维护好；浅滩可以走很远，景色绝美。

reviews.title: We go here frequently
reviews.author: Ava C
reviews.text: We go here frequently to walk, hang out in chairs on the beach. We bring lunch or dinner and enjoy the ocean view or watch the sun going down. The trail along the waterfront is a perfect walk for relaxing and just enjoying being outside. Parking is easy and plentiful in the off season.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：常来散步、在沙滩坐椅看海、看日落；滨水步道是完美的放松散步道；淡季停车又多又方便。（注：为日间游览评价，非露营）

reviews.title: Stopped on our way to Parksville
reviews.author: Denise R
reviews.text: Stopped on our way to Parksville and enjoyed a walk near the beach. No dogs are allowed on the beach although there is a small area down the way allowing dogs.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：路过停留，沿海滩散步很享受；狗不许上海滩，但远处有一小块允许遛狗的区域。（注：为日间游览评价，非露营）

reviews.title: A Visit cut Short!
reviews.author: tdsuperstar
reviews.text: A windy and cool day did not dampen our feelings of Rathrevor Beach Provincial Park. Located in the South end of Parksville, you get to enjoy the views and a ton of birds just flying around. We only had a short walk as the rain started to really fly. I'm sure we'll be back to Parksville and Rathtrevor will be on our list to go again!
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：3月风大微凉但不减好感；景色好、鸟很多；只短暂散步因下雨；下次还会来。（注：为日间游览评价，非露营）

reviews.title: Great Beach for Swimming, Sunbathing, Picnics, and Relaxation
reviews.author: Christian M
reviews.text: Parksville Beach has just enough sand for sunbathing. The problem with the many rocks and water access has been cleverly solved with blue mats laid over the rocks, allowing beachgoers to walk out and swim. The water is shallow and kid-friendly, and once past the rocks, the sandy bottom is perfect. The area is popular for picnics and family gatherings, with concerts in the evening, creating a cozy atmosphere. If you're willing to walk 100 meters, parking is free. Only the spots close to the water charge a fee.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：水浅、沙底，适合小孩；岩石区铺了蓝色垫子方便下水；野餐氛围好，晚上有音乐会；走100米可免费停车。（注：为日间游览评价，非露营）

reviews.title: Rathtrevor Beach, very impressive
reviews.author: Harold W
reviews.text: We live on the Island so have heard about the Rathtrevor Beach and Provincial Park. We had never stopped by until now. Very impressive. The camping sites were sold out and the tide was out so the beach was exposed. If you want to go sit on the beach and social distance yourself from others, this is the place to go! Lots and lots of room out there to roam or simply sit on one place and let the day go by. Highly recommended.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：住温哥华岛但第一次来，非常震撼；营位售罄、退潮露出大片沙滩；想独处看海来这里没错，地方大得很；强烈推荐。（注：为日间游览评价，非露营）

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.author: pitchew
reviews.text: Spacious sandy beach and large area to walk around away from the beach as well. There is camping, picnicking, and fun in the sun swimming or walking in the sand. No dogs allowed on the beach but you can walk the dog down a path with a view of the ocean.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：沙滩宽敞，离海滩也有大片可逛；可露营、野餐、日光浴、沙滩漫步；狗不许上海滩但可走有海景的小径。

reviews.title: Windy but spectacular
reviews.author: D1251IWkareng
reviews.text: It was a very windy, but sunny day. Walking along the beach was exhilarating, you can walk for miles. The scenery is spectacular.
reviews.ratingNote: 情感映射（页面未显示单条星级）。中文要点：风大但晴朗，沿海滩走几英里都很爽，景色壮观。（注：为日间游览评价，非露营）

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.author: Fiona L
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! We got lucky and happened to get to the beach during low tide where we were able to walk pretty far out and discovered so many things on the seabed including oysters and crabs! great place to go for all ages! NOTE: saw a sign that dogs aren't allowed out on the seabed
reviews.ratingNote: Google 评论正文（经第三方聚合页引用）。情感映射。中文要点：退潮时走到很远，发现牡蛎螃蟹等海底生物，全年龄都适合；注意标识：狗不许进入滩涂。

reviews.title: Very well maintained campground
reviews.author: D T
reviews.text: We camped at the campground for a night second week of September, it was fully occupied. This place was very well maintained, very organized and well labeled rows of campsites, very clean bathrooms, easy access to beach and nice walking trail along the waterfront. They came by to sell firewood in the evening. Sunset was beautiful and peaceful at the beach. Would definitely recommend this campground.
reviews.ratingNote: Google 评论正文（经第三方聚合页引用）。情感映射。中文要点：9月第二周一晚，满营；维护极好、营位标识清晰、厕所非常干净、去海滩方便、滨水步道好；傍晚有人来卖柴；海滩日落美而宁静；强烈推荐。

reviews.title: Fascinating beach
reviews.author: Graham Tranter
reviews.text: Fascinating beach where you wade out for great distances due to the very slight incline of the sand bar. The park itself has pleasant picnic areas, decent parking, and some interesting old tree boles.
reviews.ratingNote: Google 评论正文（经第三方聚合页引用）。情感映射。中文要点：沙洲坡度极缓，能蹚水走很远；公园野餐区宜人、停车不错、老树桩有意思。

reviews.title: Site #134 mitten im Wald
reviews.author: Gabi
reviews.text: Wir hatten Site #134 mitten im Wald. Es gibt einen schönen Strand, den wir auf einem Abendspaziergang beim Sonnenuntergang genossen haben. Die Sanitäranlagen waren gut gepflegt. Wir können den Park weiter empfehlen.
reviews.ratingNote: 德语原文保留，译文：我们住在134号营位，在森林深处。海滩很美，傍晚散步看了日落。卫生设施维护得很好。我们会推荐这个公园。情感映射。

reviews.title: Site 50, 5 Feuer
reviews.text: Wir hatten in der ersten Buchungsrunde keinen Platz ergattern können, erst nach mehrmaligem Nachschauen war plötzlich Site 50 frei. Dieser liegt weit entfernt vom Strand in der Nähe des Infohauses und der Wiese, entpuppte sich vor Ort als sehr schöner Stellplatz und von der Lage her genial, grasten abends und morgens direkt in unmittelbarer Nähe blacktailed deers (Rehe), die keine Scheu vor Menschen haben. Ausserdem hoppeln auf dem Campingplatz und vor allem im Wiesenbereich Hasen herum. Ein perfekter Ort für Kinder. Für uns 5 Feuer!
reviews.ratingNote: 页面明确给出 5 Feuer（5星）。译文：第一轮没抢到，多次刷新后突然刷到50号营位；离海滩远、靠近信息屋和草地，位置绝佳；早晚有不怕人的黑尾鹿在附近吃草，营地和草地区域还有兔子；孩子们的完美之地；我们给5星。

reviews.title: Site 68, saubere Sanitäranlagen
reviews.text: Wir verbrachten hier unsere letzte Nacht auf Vancouver Island vor der Fährüberfahrt Nanaimo - Horseshoe Bay 03.06.-04.06.2017. Wir hatten Site 68 reserviert, der Platz war gut belegt. Die sanitären Anlagen waren sauber und in Ordnung, ein großer Spielplatz ist ebenfalls vorhanden.
reviews.ratingNote: 德语原文保留，译文：在Nanaimo-Horseshoe Bay轮渡前在此住最后一晚（2017-06-03至04），预订了68号营位，营地入住率高。卫生设施干净整洁，还有大游乐场。情感映射。

reviews.title: Minst leuke camping (least favourite)
reviews.author: Tineke
reviews.text: Wij hadden onze campings door ERCTU via Tioga laten boeken, maar deze was de minst leuke. We hadden het gevoel dat we op een "Roma-camping" terecht waren gekomen. Wat een families om ons heen en wat veel grote trailers. Wij vonden er niks aan, het sanitair was prima maar niet schoon en niet echt geweldig. We hadden op de tweede rij maar hadden geen zeezicht omdat er zulke grote campers voor ons op de eerste rij stonden. Veel geschreeuw en 's nachts veel verkeer. Mogelijk van vissers? We weten het niet. Geen aanrader, misschien omdat het hoogzomer was?
reviews.source: Tioga Tours（荷兰语旅行者评论）
reviews.ratingNote: 荷兰语原文保留，译文：这是此行最不喜欢的营地；周围全是家庭和大拖挂；卫生间凑合但不干净；第二排被大车挡住无海景；吵闹、夜里车多；不推荐，可能因为是盛夏。情感映射。

reviews.title: Site 19, schone douches
reviews.author: Brenda
reviews.text: Prachtige, keurige camping in de natuur, ruime plekken. We hadden nr 19. Geen hook-up. Schone douches, gratis. Je loopt zo het strand op. Meerdere trails rondom de camping te maken.
reviews.source: Tioga Tours（荷兰语旅行者评论）
reviews.ratingNote: 荷兰语原文保留，译文：大自然中美丽整洁的营地，营位宽敞，我们住19号。无接驳。淋浴干净且免费。步行即到海滩。营地周围有多条步道。情感映射。
